scope: Nepal medical discovery — Tribhuvan University Institute of Medicine / Maharajgunj Medical Campus

institution.programme: Bachelor of Medicine, Bachelor of Surgery (MBBS)

verifiedFacts.claim: IOM lists MBBS among its programmes and says admission to its programmes requires passing the Medical Education Commission combined entrance examination.
Maharajgunj Medical Campus is a public Tribhuvan University MBBS institution with 100 total seats and 8 foreign seats in the MECEE-BL 2025 allocation.
The Medical Education Commission's foreign-category MBBS matching list includes Maharajgunj Medical Campus placements.
Nepal Medical Council identifies itself as the statutory regulator that monitors and regulates medical education in Nepal.
